Milio kicks a fireball, Knocking Back the first enemy hit. If it hits, the ball bounces past them and explodes, dealing [80 / 140 / 200 / 260 / 320 + (1.2) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies and Slowing them by [0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 + (0.0005) × AP] for [1.5] seconds.

Hitting at least one enemy champion with {{Spell_MilioKickballQ_Name}} refunds [50]% of it's Mana cost.

builds.summary: Investigate high two overlapping Warm Hugs shields on one ally output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high two overlapping Warm Hugs shields on one ally output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.

builds.name: Fired Up: fixed-ally proc and burn
builds.summary: Explore high one Fired Up allied proc and its complete burn output with a finite preparation; compare alternatives rather than claiming an absolute maximum.
builds.goal: Explore high one Fired Up allied proc and its complete burn output with a finite preparation; compare alternatives rather than claiming an absolute maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Fired Up grants a level-breakpoint fraction of the triggering ally AD as magic damage plus a burn with 0.20 Milio AP over 1.5 seconds. At level 18 the burst ratio helper is 15%; the burn base remains unresolved in the expression despite a raw 10-to-50 range, so read its actual client value.
